integrity: The all-state step uses the independently checked four-mode Gaussian-fidelity normal form; the bridge-kernel computation is proved analytically and replayed by an exact rational checker. Finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The exact law is proved for normalized positive-parity pure states of exactly four complex fermionic modes and the standard two-copy zero-bridge-sector Bell test. It is not asserted for mixed states, higher mode number, tolerant two-threshold testing, or arbitrary collective finite-sample tests.
title: Exact four-mode Bell-sampling soundness from Gaussian fidelity
